scalars.scalar_value: Experience in customer service, and ability to demonstrate professional expertise.

items.item_text: Experience in safeguarding and securing various instruments of value, including vehicle keys, fuel cards, license plates and checks.
Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.
Experience in customer service, and ability to demonstrate professional expertise.
Experience in having responsibility for multiple administrative duties, including, but not limited to facilitation of vehicle accident reporting, DMV and service garage administrative functions.
Experience in classifying and analyzing a variety of detailed records, including inventory and service records.
Experience in reconciliation of procurement card purchases, receipts and purchase orders.

Under supervision of the Fleet Operations Manager, the Fleet Administrative Assistant is responsible for multiple administrative duties, including the facilitation of vehicle accident reporting, Department of Motor Vehicle (DMV) administrative functions, assisting with garage administrative functions, and service appointment scheduling. Facilitate account payable functions and handle vehicle rental processing. Exhibit a positive customer service orientation that includes internal and external customers. Utilize a Fleet Management Information System to facilitate multiple areas of business administration functions. Will assist with administering spare keys for vehicles and fuel cards. Assist with managing campus fuel supply with the aid of a fuel monitoring system. Reconcile Procurement Card purchases, receipts, and purchase orders. Assist with parts inventory accountability.

Excellent verbal and written interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work individually or in teams to communicate effectively with people of many diverse backgrounds including students, staff, faculty and customers. Legible handwriting, attention to detail, excellent organizational skills and ability to maintain accurate records and files. Strong organizational skills to handle multiple tasks and priorities under strict deadlines.
Innovative problem solving skills and exercising good judgement. Effective interpersonal communication skills utilizing tact, diplomacy and discretion to interact with a diverse customer base.
Ability to maintain professional relationships with venders through effective and clear communications.

Demonstrated strong computer skills using various financial and administrative software tools such as: spreadsheets, databases and web browsers including but not limited to: Word, Excel, Outlook, and other MS Suite applications. Ability to utilize a Fleet Management Information System database, CAMS and to learn new applications as required. Ability to generate reports as needed.

Proven skill to clearly and concisely provide information and compose correspondence using correct grammar, punctuation, spelling, format and proof reading skills. Ability to compile information, analyze and prepare summary reports in a comprehensive and professional format
Demonstrated knowledge of California Department of Motor Vehicle regulations and processes.
Knowledge of arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication and division) in order to recognize, compute and reconcile errors.
Basic analytical skills to organize data, recognize and corrects errors as necessary.
Ability to understand and utilize a vehicle telematics (GPS) system, and to maintain information confidentiality.
Ability to facilitate parts inventory accountability, including ordering and audit preparation.
Ability to model and advocate UCSD Principles of Community.
